list.title: What is a Proxy? Why Use One? How to Use a Proxy for Navigating the Internet
list.subheading: Unlocking the Power of Proxies: How They Work and Why You Need One
list.excerpt: Discover what a proxy server is, why you should use one, and how to configure proxies for browsing the internet securely. Learn to set up proxies in browsers, system settings, and JavaScript applications.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: How to Use Tor via CLI on Ubuntu to Anonymize Internet Traffic
list.excerpt: Learn how to install and configure Tor via CLI on Ubuntu to anonymize your internet traffic. This guide covers SOCKS5 proxy, Privoxy, ProxyChains, SSH tunneling, and accessing the dark web securely.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: The Unvarnished Truth About Cyber Anonymity: A Double-Edged Sword
list.subheading: Beyond the VPN: Why True Online Invisibility is a Myth, and the Moral Tightrope We Walk
list.excerpt: Explore the brutal realities of cyber anonymity. Learn why technical tools like Tor and VPNs aren't magic bullets, the essential role of OpSec, and the dark ethical dilemmas that define online privacy today.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: The War on Fakes: A Brutally Honest Guide to Hunting Sockpuppet Accounts
list.subheading: I's not just about IP addresses. Why community trust depends on exposing the manipulators hiding in plain sight.
list.excerpt: Learn how to analyze a community for sockpuppet accounts using technical signals, behavioral analysis, and Python scripts. A brutally honest guide for moderators.
list.author: Paul Serban
